children: The engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) arm of the Waaree Group, Waaree Renewable Technologies Ltd,on Thursday (November 26) said it has received a letter of award (LOA) for a 120 megawatt-peak (MWp) turnkey solar project involving the supply of modules and execution of engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) works.
The order has been awarded by a domestic private limited company. However, it did not disclose the name of the awarding entity or the financial value of the contract.
The project is scheduled to be completed during the financial year 2027-28, as per the terms of the order. Waaree Renewable Technologies received the letter of award on November 26 at 5:17 pm (IST).
The company said the order does not involve any interest of its promoters, promoter group or group companies in the awarding entity. The contract also does not fall under related-party transactions.

Waaree Renewable Technologies reported a 30% year-on-year decline in net profit to ₹82 crore for the September quarter of FY27, compared with ₹116 crore a year earlier. Revenue from operations increased 36.53% to ₹1,057.84 crore from ₹775 crore in the same quarter last year.

However, earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) rose only 1.3% to ₹160 crore from ₹158 crore. The EBITDA margin, which measures operating profit as a share of revenue, fell to 15% from 20% a year ago.
For the six months ended September 2026, revenue from operations grew 43.84% year-on-year to ₹1,982.09 crore, compared with ₹1,377.97 crore in the first half of FY26.
EBITDA increased 21.04% to ₹333.46 crore from ₹275.49 crore. However, net profit remained largely unchanged at ₹200.44 crore, compared with ₹202.75 crore in the year-ago period.
The company said acquisition-related financing costs and the addition of businesses with different profit margins had affected its profitability in the near term.
Shares of Waaree Renewable Technologies Ltd ended at ₹687.85, up by ₹13.00, or 1.93%, on the BSE.

title: Waaree Renewable Technologies bags 120 MWp solar EPC order, completion scheduled in FY28
